# Hypothesis: Attenuating four layer-18 columns associated with the observed self-check motif will selectively reduce its likelihood; norm and loop-activity matched nonselective columns provide a fixed control.
selected_columns = [1261,1405,1824,1784]
layer18 = all_arrays["layer_18"]
babs18, gabs18, norms18 = layer18[0], layer18[1], layer18[7]
control_pool = [int(j) for j in range(3584) if j not in selected_columns and abs(np.log((babs18[j]+1e-8)/(gabs18[j]+1e-8))) <= np.log(1.1)]
control_columns = []
control_matches = []
for target in selected_columns:
    candidates = [j for j in control_pool if j not in control_columns]
    distances = [float(np.log((norms18[j]+1e-8)/(norms18[target]+1e-8))**2 + np.log((babs18[j]+1e-8)/(babs18[target]+1e-8))**2) for j in candidates]
    control = candidates[int(np.argmin(distances))]
    control_columns.append(control)
    control_matches.append({"target":target,"control":control,"target_norm":float(norms18[target]),"control_norm":float(norms18[control]),"norm_relative_deviation":float(norms18[control]/norms18[target]-1),"target_loop_mean_abs":float(babs18[target]),"control_loop_mean_abs":float(babs18[control]),"activity_relative_deviation":float(babs18[control]/babs18[target]-1),"control_loop_reference_ratio":float(babs18[control]/gabs18[control])})
weight_name = "model.language_model.layers.18.mlp.down_proj.weight"
original_weight = load_original(weight_name)
variant_results = []
for variant,alpha,columns in [("alpha025",.25,selected_columns),("alpha050",.5,selected_columns),("alpha100",1.,selected_columns),("control100",1.,control_columns)]:
    weight = original_weight.clone()
    weight[:,columns] = (1-alpha)*original_weight[:,columns]
    save_edit(weight_name,weight)
    np.save("results/astra_clean_20261103/variants/"+variant+"/"+weight_name+".npy",weight.numpy())
    np.save("results/astra_clean_20261103/deltas/"+variant+"/"+weight_name+".npy",(weight-original_weight).numpy())
    variant_results.append({"variant":variant,"alpha":alpha,"columns":columns,"relative_weight_norm_change":float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(weight-original_weight)/torch.linalg.vector_norm(original_weight)),"changed_elements":int(torch.count_nonzero(weight-original_weight))})
drop_edit(weight_name)
result = {"target_columns":selected_columns,"control_columns":control_columns,"control_selection":"Fixed greedy closest log-norm/log-loop-mean-absolute-activation; loop/reference ratio required within [1/1.1,1.1]; no outcome-based replacement.","control_matches":control_matches,"variants":variant_results,"active_edits_after_export":edited()}
